snippet.title: The Economy Is Rigged! (BoomER Ville Land Trailer)
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for BoomER Ville Land—a satirical browser board game poking fun at modern economic chaos, housing crisis, and inflation. 🎲🔥

Search "BoomER Ville Land" on itch.io to play free in your browser!

About BoomER Ville Land:
A satirical indie game built for web browsers. 

#BrowserGames #IndieDev #Satire #BoardGames #Gamedev #Indiegames
